slot.brief: Rigid rod or ladder in equilibrium; find torque about a chosen point to get an unknown force

stem: A uniform horizontal rod of length $4$ m and mass $8$ kg is hinged at one end and held by a vertical string at the other. A $12$ kg load hangs $3$ m from the hinge. Find the string tension. Take $g = 10$ m s$^{-2}$.

verdicts.working: Taking moments about the hinge: 4T = 80(2) + 120(3), so T = 130 N.

working:
$4T = (8 \times 10)(2) + (12 \times 10)(3)$
$4T = 520$
$T = 130$ N

Independent check: Taking moments about the hinge: 4T = 80(2) + 120(3), so T = 130 N.
